```{r}

rm(list = ls())
library(qiime2R)
library(tidyverse)
library(ape)

feature_table <-read_qza("../artifacts/table.qza")$data
taxonomy_annot <- read_qza('../artifacts/taxonomy_classification/taxonomy.qza')$data
taxonomy_annot <-taxonomy_annot %>% mutate(taxa = str_remove_all(Taxon, "D_\\d__")) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(taxa, "; ", names = c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", 
                                             "Family", "Genus", "Species"), too_few = "align_start") %>%
   mutate_at(c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", 
               "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), list(~ substr(., 4, nchar(.))))

library(dplyr)

# Step 1: Select only the v2 and v6 columns
BL_ft <- feature_table %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(ends_with(c("v2", "v6")))   # cleaner syntax

TR_ft <- feature_table %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(ends_with(c("v7", "v8"))) 

# Step 2: Calculate prevalence = fraction of samples where each feature is present (≥1)
prevalence_BL <- rowMeans(BL_ft >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)   
prevalence_TR <- rowMeans(TR_ft >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)  

# If you also want to merge prevalence with taxonomy annotation
# (e.g. to get the prevalence of each feature along with its taxonomy)
prevalence_df <- data.frame(
  Feature.ID = names(prevalence_BL),
  prevalence_BL = prevalence_BL,
  prevalence_TR = prevalence_TR
) %>%
  filter(prevalence_BL >= 0.30 | prevalence_TR>= 0.30) %>%
  left_join(taxonomy_annot, by = "Feature.ID")   # much cleaner than merge()

keep_cols <- prevalence_df$Feature.ID

```


differentially abundant taxa for each visit
```{r}
sel_visit<-"v8"
asv_meta <- read.csv("../../phylogentic_tree/exported-tree/asv_metadata_f30.csv")
DA_asvs <- read.csv("../export/linDA_ASVs_Sig_LFC1.csv")
colorstrip_data <- DA_asvs %>% merge(asv_meta %>% select(Feature.ID),by.x = "taxa",by.y = "Feature.ID",all=T) %>%
  filter(visit == !!sel_visit) %>%
  mutate(
    label = taxa,
    color = case_when(
      log2FoldChange <= -2   ~ "#8F0177",   # strong decrease – dark purple
      log2FoldChange <= -1   ~ "#F63049",   # moderate decrease – red/pink
      log2FoldChange < 2     ~ "#33A1E0",   # weak / no strong change – light blue
      log2FoldChange >= 2    ~ "#093FB4",    # strong increase ≥ +2 – dark blue
      TRUE                   ~ "#FFFFFF"
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(label, color, log2FoldChange)

data_lines <- colorstrip_data %>%
  mutate(label = as.character(label)) %>%
  mutate(line = paste(label, color, sep = ",")) %>%
  pull(line)

header <- c(
  "DATASET_COLORSTRIP",
  "SEPARATOR COMMA",
  paste0("DATASET_LABEL,Diff ASVs", sel_visit),
  "COLOR,#F5F0CD",
  "COLOR_BRANCHES,0",
  "STRIP_WIDTH,30",
  "STRIP_LABEL_AUTO_COLOR,0",
  "STRIP_LABEL_POSITION,center",
  "STRIP_LABEL_ROTATION,90",
  "SHOW_STRIP_LABELS,0",
  "MARGIN,2",
  "LEGEND_TITLE,Diff_ASV",
  "#LEGEND_SCALE 1",
  "#LEGEND_POSITION_X 100",
  "#LEGEND_POSITION_Y 100",
  "#LEGEND_HORIZONTAL 0",
  "LEGEND_SHAPES,1,1",
  "LEGEND_COLORS,#8F0177,#F63049,#33A1E0,#093FB4,#FFFDF6",
  "LEGEND_LABELS,LFC<=-2,LFC<=-1,LFC<2,LFC>=2,No Change",
  "#LEGEND_SHAPE_SCALES 1,1,1,1,1",
  "SHOW_LABELS,0",
  "BORDER_WIDTH,1",
  "BORDER_COLOR,#FFFFFF",
  "COMPLETE_BORDER,1",
  "DATA"
)
full_content <- c(header, data_lines)
writeLines(full_content, paste0("../../phylogentic_tree/exported-tree/itol/itol_colorstrip_diff_ASVs",sel_visit,".txt"))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)   # for hue_pal() or other color generators

# Assume your dataframe is called 'metadata'
# It contains at least: Feature.ID, Genus, Family, Order
# (Feature.ID should match the leaf names in your iTOL tree)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Function to create one colorstrip dataset for a given rank
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
create_colorstrip_for_rank <- function(
    df,
    rank_column,                # "Genus", "Family", "Order"
    dataset_label = rank_column,
    strip_width = 50,
    label_position = "center",
    label_rotation = 90,
    output_file = NULL
) {
  
  # Step 1: Group by the rank, get unique values, assign random colors
  unique_colors <- df %>%
    group_by(!!sym(rank_column)) %>%
    summarize() %>%  # just unique
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(rank_column))) %>%
    mutate(
      color = hue_pal()(n()) %>% sample()  # random distinct colors
    )
  
  # Step 2: Merge back with original DF to assign colors to each Feature.ID
  colored_df <- df %>%
    left_join(unique_colors, by = rank_column) %>%
    filter(!is.na(color))  # drop any NA ranks
  
  # Step 3: Prepare data lines: Feature.ID,color,label (where label = rank value)
  data_lines <- colored_df %>%
    mutate(
      label = as.character(!!sym(rank_column)),
      line = paste(Feature.ID, color, label, sep = ",")
    ) %>%
    pull(line)
  
  # ── Header (no legend, per-strip labels) ─────────────────────────────────
  header <- c(
    "DATASET_COLORSTRIP",
    "SEPARATOR COMMA",
    str_glue("DATASET_LABEL,{dataset_label}"),
    "COLOR,#eeeeee",                    # fallback
    "COLOR_BRANCHES,0",
    str_glue("STRIP_WIDTH,{strip_width}"),
    "STRIP_LABEL_AUTO_COLOR,0",
    str_glue("STRIP_LABEL_POSITION,{label_position}"),
    str_glue("STRIP_LABEL_ROTATION,{label_rotation}"),
    "SHOW_STRIP_LABELS,1",
    "MARGIN,5",
    "SHOW_LABELS,1",
    "BORDER_WIDTH,1",
    "BORDER_COLOR,#444444",
    "COMPLETE_BORDER,1",
    "DATA"
  )
  
  full_content <- c(header, data_lines)
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    writeLines(full_content, output_file)
    message("Written: ", output_file, "  (", length(data_lines), " rows)")
  }
  
  invisible(full_content)
}
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Create three separate files
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

create_colorstrip_for_rank(
  asv_meta,
  rank_column   = "Genus",
  dataset_label = "Genus",
  output_file   = "../../phylogentic_tree/exported-tree/itol/itol_colorstrip_Genus.txt"
)

create_colorstrip_for_rank(
  asv_meta,
  rank_column   = "Family",
  dataset_label = "Family",
  output_file   = "../../phylogentic_tree/exported-tree/itol/itol_colorstrip_Family.txt"
)

create_colorstrip_for_rank(
  asv_meta,
  rank_column   = "Order",
  dataset_label = "Order",
  output_file   = "../../phylogentic_tree/exported-tree/itol/itol_colorstrip_Order.txt"
)
```

```{r}
abundance_df <- read.csv("../export/clr_normalizations_asvs.csv")
metadata<-read_q2metadata("../artifacts/metadata.tsv")
# 1. Prepare long format and join visits
abundance_long <- abundance_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -X, names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(SampleID, visit), by = "SampleID") %>%
  filter(visit %in% c("v2", "v6", "v7", "v8"))

median_df <- abundance_long %>%
  group_by(X, visit) %>%
  summarise(median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = visit, values_from = median_value, values_fill = NA)

median_df <- median_df %>%
  select(X, v2, v6, v7, v8)

data_lines <- median_df %>%
  mutate(across(-X, ~ format(., scientific = FALSE, digits = 4))) %>%  # clean numbers
  mutate(line = paste(X, v2, v6, v7, v8, sep = "\t")) %>%
  pull(line)

# 4. Define iTOL heatmap header (customize as needed)
header <- c(
  "DATASET_HEATMAP",
  "SEPARATOR TAB",
  "DATASET_LABEL\tMedians per visit",
  "COLOR\t#ffff00",  # fallback color (yellowish)
  "COLOR_MIN\t#0571b0",  # low values: blue
  "COLOR_MAX\t#ca0020",  # high values: red
  "COLOR_NA\t#cccccc",   # gray for NA
  "USE_MID_COLOR\t1",    # use mid color for 0 (if values can be negative)
  "COLOR_MID\t#ffffff",  # white for mid/zero
  "FIELD_LABELS\tv2\tv6\tv7\tv8",
  "FIELD_SHAPES\t1\t1\t1\t1",  # rectangles
  "MARGIN\t5",
  "SHOW_INTERNAL\t0",
  "BORDER_WIDTH\t0.5",
  "BORDER_COLOR\t#000000",
  "AUTO_LEGEND\t1",  # auto-generate legend based on colors
  "LEGEND_TITLE\tMedian value",
  "LEGEND_SHAPES\t1",
  "LEGEND_COLORS\t#0571b0\t#ffffff\t#ca0020",
  "LEGEND_LABELS\tLow\tMid\tHigh",
  "DATA"
)

# 5. Combine and write to file
full_content <- c(header, data_lines)
writeLines(full_content, "../../phylogentic_tree/exported-tree/itol/itol_heatmap_medians_CLR_counts.txt")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

sel_visit <- "v7"
asv_meta <- read.csv("../../phylogentic_tree/exported-tree/asv_metadata_f30.csv")
DA_asvs  <- read.csv("../export/linDA_ASVs_Sig_LFC1.csv")

# Prepare data
data <- DA_asvs %>% 
  merge(asv_meta %>% select(Feature.ID), by.x = "taxa", by.y = "Feature.ID", all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(visit == sel_visit, !is.na(taxa), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  mutate(id = taxa, value = log2FoldChange)

# Positive bars (right, blue shades)
pos <- data %>% 
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  mutate(color = ifelse(value >= 2, "#093FB4", "#33A1E0"))

pos_lines <- pos %>% 
  mutate(line = paste(id, format(value, digits = 4), sep = ",")) %>% 
  pull(line)

pos_header <- c(
  "DATASET_SIMPLEBAR",
  "SEPARATOR COMMA",
  "DATASET_LABEL,Positive log2FC v8",
  "COLOR,#33A1E0",
  "BAR_MIN,0",
  "BAR_MAX,6",
  "WIDTH,40",
  "ALIGN,0",
  "MARGIN,5",
  "SHOW_VALUES,1",
  "VALUE_POSITION,inside",
  "LEGEND_TITLE,Positive",
  "LEGEND_COLORS,#33A1E0,#093FB4",
  "LEGEND_LABELS,Weak,Strong",
  "DATA"
)

writeLines(c(pos_header, pos_lines), "../../phylogentic_tree/exported-tree/itol/itol_simplebar_positive_v7.txt")

# Negative bars (left, red/purple shades)
neg <- data %>% 
  filter(value < 0) %>%
  mutate(color = ifelse(value <= -2, "#8F0177", "#F63049"))

neg_lines <- neg %>% 
  mutate(line = paste(id, format(value, digits = 4), sep = ",")) %>% 
  pull(line)

neg_header <- c(
  "DATASET_SIMPLEBAR",
  "SEPARATOR COMMA",
  "DATASET_LABEL,Negative log2FC v8",
  "COLOR,#F63049",
  "BAR_MIN,-6",
  "BAR_MAX,0",
  "WIDTH,40",
  "ALIGN,0",
  "MARGIN,5",
  "SHOW_VALUES,1",
  "VALUE_POSITION,inside",
  "LEGEND_TITLE,Negative",
  "LEGEND_COLORS,#F63049,#8F0177",
  "LEGEND_LABELS,Weak,Strong",
  "DATA"
)

writeLines(c(neg_header, neg_lines), "../../phylogentic_tree/exported-tree/itol/itol_simplebar_negative_v7.txt")

message("Files created: itol_simplebar_positive_v8.txt & itol_simplebar_negative_v8.txt")
```
